title: Will AI expose the rickety infrastructure of the internet?
summary: The moment you realize the internet is "held together by glue and dreams."
llm_summary: The piece argues that as AI tools start probing deeper into the web’s inner workings, they’re revealing just how fragile and improvised the internet’s architecture really is—more a patchwork of legacy systems, quick fixes and “glue” code than a solid, unified platform. In other words, AI is acting like a spotlight that exposes the tangled, dream‑driven scaffolding that keeps the global network running.
